not_planned.reason: Signing in or up (magic link, Google or Facebook) can create an account and grants OAuth; the brief's hard limits forbid it. You sign in yourself, then adopt-session stores the cookie.
Password reset and sign-up confirmation are account-security e-mail flows; the hard limits forbid changing account security, and the web has no password sign-in.
Analytics (POST /api/2/logevents) is noise; the program never sends it.

risks: You are signed out of citymapper.com; 19 session commands stay blocked until you sign in yourself and run adopt-session (whoami still answers signed out).
Citymapper Pass and Club are paid and app-only; the six pass-* commands are blocked even with a web session.
15 endpoints were read from the bundle and never observed; some may be retired upstream (each is replayed once in engineer).
Live transit values change every request; checks are on schemas and invariants only.
Cloudflare fronts the site; unknown rate thresholds; the pacer stops the client on any 429 or challenge.
City pages are 2 to 15 MB of HTML; the catalogue must be cached, never fetched per command.
